policy: User-approved labelled configurable emulator defaults; not recovered exact historical values
instructions: SET session variables before sourcing candidate SQL. Nonmatching existing managed row values abort rather than silently overwrite; deliberate configuration changes require reviewed migration.

escort_movement_contract.destination: Native NPC::MoveTo(saveguardspot=true) applies server GetFixedZ; Lua arrival uses exact GetGuardPointXYZ while requiring guarded XY to match the current waypoint.
escort_movement_contract.movement: Original Simu walks; elapsed time, a dead ambusher alone, or client proximity cannot grant arrival.
escort_movement_contract.emergency_reset: Failure/reload only; restores original guard spot and grants no objective credit.
escort_movement_contract.route_origin: Native Mesa navmesh corridor excluding zone-line flags and actual client zone-line volumes with labelled32XY/12Z clearance; not original historical escort grid.
